vulnerability.title: libexpat before 2.4.9 heap use-after-free in doContent when internalEntityProcessor returns unclosed raw tag names pointing into the parse buffer

fixed_releases.verified_content: At R_2_4_9 the internalEntityProcessor branch calls storeRawNames(parser) after doContent and returns XML_ERROR_NO_MEMORY if it fails; at the R_2_4_4 snapshot the branch directly returns doContent's result. The change is contained in R_2_4_9 and absent from R_2_4_4 and R_2_4_8.

fix_commits.message: Ensure raw tagnames are safe exiting internalEntityParser

vulnerability.category_l2: Use-after-free: tag->rawName can still point into a discarded or reallocated XML parse buffer

critical_operation.description: internalEntityProcessor() is installed as m_processor when an internal entity substitution is suspended mid-buffer (line 5613), so XML_ResumeParser resumes directly into it. In its DTD-off/entity-substitution branch it sets m_processor = contentProcessor and returns doContent(...) directly (line 5688). doContent can return with unclosed tags; those tags' rawName fields still point into the current parse buffer (the storeRawNames comment at lines 2555-2559 says rawName initially always points into the parse buffer, and storeRawNames is what copies it out). Because this path never calls storeRawNames, an application that feeds the parser in chunks and calls XML_GetBuffer between calls can have the buffer reallocated or moved while tag->rawName still references the old allocation; the next name access is a heap use-after-free. The 2.4.9 fix 4a32da8 wraps the doContent result and calls storeRawNames(parser) whenever doContent returned XML_ERROR_NONE. CWE-416.

entry_point.description: An application parses attacker-supplied XML in chunks: an internal entity substitution suspends parsing, XML_ResumeParser re-enters internalEntityProcessor, doContent leaves unclosed tags, and the application reallocates the parse buffer with XML_GetBuffer before continuing.

source_crosscheck.notes: NVD Primary and CISA-ADP Secondary publish the identical 8.1 High vector, and OSV carries the same vector; the CNA publishes no metric, so there is no conflicting score. All records agree the defect is before 2.4.9 and the CVE description names doContent. The upstream Changes entry 721169e explicitly attributes CVE-2022-40674 to PR #629/#640, and 4a32da8 is the only code change of PR #629 (merged as dde178b). OSV's fixed GIT event points at the 2.4.9 release merge d77291a4 rather than the code commit; local ancestry shows 4a32da8 is first contained in R_2_4_9.

independent_corrections_accepted: Line-span precision: the claimed whole-function range 5629-5692 is the function body through the critical block's closing brace; internalEntityProcessor's own closing brace is line 5693 and its declarator line is 5628. The claimed critical block 5686-5692 and the direct doContent return 5688-5691 are exact. The record keeps the body range 5629-5692 and records the reviewer's full-function range 5628-5693.

Attribution nuance: the CNA description and the upstream Changes entry say 'in the doContent function', while the record locates the missing storeRawNames in internalEntityProcessor; the stale pointer is read by doContent's closing-tag memcmp at xmlparse.c:3014-3015. The record's mechanism narrative already splits defect site and read site this way.
OSV fixed event d77291a is the R_2_4_9 release merge of PR #644, not the code commit 4a32da8; the record already states this and derives the code fix from upstream Changes/PR #629.

Reachability: attacker XML content is necessary but not sufficient; the embedding application must suspend from a handler during internal-entity substitution, resume, then grow/reallocate the buffer via XML_GetBuffer or a later chunk larger than INIT_BUFFER_SIZE 1024. Consistent with AC:H and SSVC Automatable: no; the record states this precondition.

Alias semantics: DEBIAN-CVE-2022-40674 is a Debian OSV advisory record whose upstream is CVE-2022-40674 (Debian fix 2.4.8-2), not an alias inside the CVE record; it is kept as a downstream cross-reference.
review.duplicate_check: Reviewer confirmed CVE-2022-43680 is a distinct shared-DTD destruction use-after-free in XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate (PR #650/#649/#616, through 2.4.9, CVSS 7.5), and that the five 2.4.5 CVEs (25235/25236/25313/25314/25315) are different root causes, including 25315's integer overflow in storeRawNames (eb03628).

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No XML document was parsed, no parser was built and no sanitizer run was performed; the use-after-free is established statically from the missing storeRawNames call and the buffer-lifetime comment.
The trigger needs chunked parsing with a buffer reallocation between calls plus an internal entity substitution that suspends parsing; not every libexpat embedding feeds chunks this way.
Only R_2_4_4 was compared against R_2_4_9; R_2_4_5 through R_2_4_8 were not diffed individually, although the fix is absent from R_2_4_8 by ancestry.
The CNA record itself carries no CVSS or CWE; severity and weakness come from NVD/CISA-ADP and OSV.
OSV's fixed GIT event is the release merge d77291a4; the code fix is 4a32da8, established from upstream commits and the Changes file rather than from the OSV event.

The reviewer verified snapshot blobs against the inventory (R_2_4_4:expat/lib/xmlparse.c = 4b43e613) and read the 4a32da8 patch, the 721169e Changes entry and the a7ce80a regression test, but nothing was built, parsed or executed.
The whole-function location range is the body 5629-5692; the function's own closing brace is 5693 and its declarator line is 5628. The critical block 5686-5692 and the return 5688-5691 are exact.
open_questions: Whether the use-after-free is reliably exploitable for code execution (rather than only denial of service) was not assessed; the upstream Changes text says denial of service or potentially arbitrary code execution.
